scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Why don't you come back after becoming stronger?
Maybe, level 130.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
等你变强了再来吧。
也许，130级的时候。

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
A long time ago, this castle did not look like this.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
很久以前，这座城堡并不是现在这个样子。

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Ah, I'm sorry. I'm muttering in front of a stranger.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
啊，抱歉。我在陌生人面前自言自语了。

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
My name is Hugin. I'm studying the dimensional gap between time and space.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
我叫胡金。我正在研究时间与空间之间的次元裂缝。

scripts.text: There's something like that here?
scripts.translation: 这里也有那样的东西吗？

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Have you ever wondered about the history of Glast Heim?
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
你有没有想过格拉斯特海姆的历史？

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
There was a King named Shumiche who was known as a tyrant in the history of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
卢恩·米德加兹王国历史上有一位名叫舒米切的国王，他被称为暴君。

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Time will reveal the true answers if we look in the right places.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
如果我们找对地方，时间会揭示真正的答案。

scripts.text: I don't care about history
scripts.translation: 我对历史不感兴趣

scripts.text: That is interesting. Did you find anything?
scripts.translation: 这很有趣。你发现了什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Really? Hmm, please come back later when you are interested then.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
真的吗？嗯，等你感兴趣的时候再回来吧。

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Actually, dimensional time travel is possible but I'm too afraid to go there.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
其实，维度时间旅行是可能的，但我太害怕了，不敢去。

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
It might be possible for you!
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
也许你可以做到！

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Do you want to time travel?
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
你想进行时间旅行吗？

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text: Yes, of course I do!
scripts.translation: 当然想！

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Really? But, jumping gigawatts, this is such a great opportunity.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
真的吗？天哪，这可是千载难逢的好机会。

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
I knew that you would understand what I said. Well, please tell me what you want to do.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
我就知道你会理解我的意思。那么，请告诉我你想做什么。

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Umm? Did you see me at another place? I don't think so. What about this time?
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
嗯？你在别的地方见过我吗？我不觉得。那这次呢？

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Why don't you make a party with more than 1 person and talk to me again?
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
你为什么不组建一个超过1人的队伍，然后再来找我呢？

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Have we met before? No way. It's my first time seeing you. What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
我们以前见过吗？不可能。这是我第一次见到你。你想做什么？

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Have we met before? No way. It's my first time seeing you. What do you want?
[Hugin]
After the time gap opens, please tell me again.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
我们以前见过吗？不可能。这是我第一次见到你。你想做什么？
[胡金]
时间裂隙开启后，请再告诉我一次。

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Have we met before? No way. It's my first time seeing you. What do you want?
[Hugin]
An unknown error has occurred.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
我们以前见过吗？不可能。这是我第一次见到你。你想做什么？
[胡金]
发生了未知错误。

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Have we met before? No way. It's my first time seeing you. What do you want?
[Hugin]
The time gap is not yet open.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
我们以前见过吗？不可能。这是我第一次见到你。你想做什么？
[胡金]
时间裂隙尚未开启。

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Have we met before? No way. It's my first time seeing you. What do you want?
[Hugin]
Your body is not fit to enter the time gap. You won't be able to get in if you're not in a party.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
我们以前见过吗？不可能。这是我第一次见到你。你想做什么？
[胡金]
你的身体状态不适合进入时间裂隙。如果没有加入队伍，你将无法进入。

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Have we met before? No way. It's my first time seeing you. What do you want?
[Hugin]
Oh, my...
You still have after-effects of time travel. You can't travel again with this condition.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
我们以前见过吗？不可能。这是我第一次见到你。你想做什么？
[胡金]
哎呀...
你身上还残留着时间旅行的后遗症。在这种状态下，你无法再次进行旅行。

scripts.text: Enter Old Glast Heim
scripts.translation: 进入旧格拉斯特海姆

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
After the time gap opens, please tell me again.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
时间裂隙开启后，请再告诉我一次。

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
An unknown error has occurred.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
发生了未知错误。

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
The time gap is not yet open.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
时间裂隙尚未开启。

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Your body is not fit to enter the time gap. You won't be able to get in if you're not in a party.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
你的身体状态不适合进入时间裂隙。如果没有加入队伍，你将无法进入。

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Oh, my...
You still have after-effects of time travel. You can't travel again with this condition.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
哎呀...
你身上还残留着时间旅行的后遗症。在这种状态下，你无法再次进行旅行。

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Staying healthy is important, so please take a break and come back again later.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
保持健康很重要，请休息一下，稍后再来。

scripts.text: ^0000ffAll traces of access to Old Glast Heim have been removed. Now you can talk with Hugin again.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff所有访问旧格拉斯特海姆的痕迹已被清除。现在你可以再次与胡金交谈了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Varmundt]
Where's your leader? I need his help.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔蒙特]
你的首领在哪里？我需要他的帮助。

scripts.text: You have a previous clear record. You can skip the scenario and proceed accordingly.
scripts.translation: 你有之前的通关记录。你可以跳过剧情并相应地继续。

scripts.text: Omit moderately.
scripts.translation: 适度跳过

scripts.text: Appreciate everything.
scripts.translation: 完整体验

scripts.text:
[Varmundt]
I've seen you, {0}.
I'm sure I can trust you. Let's leave right away.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔蒙特]
我见过你，{0}。
我相信我可以信任你。我们马上出发吧。

scripts.text:
[Varmundt]
Are you the one ^0000ffHerico^000000 sent to help me?
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔蒙特]
你是^0000ff赫里科^000000派来帮我的吗？

scripts.text: Oh. Well I...
scripts.translation: 哦，那个我...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah yes, I am. Herico told me to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，是的。赫里科让我来见你。

scripts.text:
[Varmundt]
We don't have much time. We must report to Sir Heinrich about Himelmez's invasion.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔蒙特]
我们没时间了。必须向海因里希爵士报告希梅尔梅兹的入侵。

scripts.text: Himelmez...
scripts.translation: 希梅尔梅兹...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Who is Himelmez?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
希梅尔梅兹是谁？

scripts.text:
[Varmundt]
Herico didn't tell you?
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔蒙特]
赫里科没告诉你吗？

scripts.text:
[Varmundt]
She is the Ruler of Death, Dead man's Valkyrie. Himelmez is looking to take the heart of Ymir from us.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔蒙特]
她是死亡统治者，亡者的瓦尔基里。希梅尔梅兹正想夺走我们的尤弥尔之心。

scripts.text:
[Varmundt]
She might even destroy this whole castle if she wanted to.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔蒙特]
如果她想的话，甚至能摧毁整座城堡。

scripts.text:
[Varmundt]
Hurry! Report to Sir. Heinrich about Himelmez. I must check the defense barrier here!
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔蒙特]
快！去海因里希爵士那里报告希梅尔梅兹的事。我得去检查这里的防御结界！

scripts.text:
[Khalitzburg Knightage]
My work shift will be over soon, but the next crew is not coming.
scripts.translation:
[卡利兹堡骑士团]
我的班快结束了，但下一班的人还没来。

scripts.text:
[Khalitzburg Knightage]
Something you want to tell me?
scripts.translation:
[卡利兹堡骑士团]
有什么事要告诉我吗？

scripts.text:
[White Knight]
Are you with Varmundt? Commander is waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[白骑士]
你是瓦尔蒙特的人吗？指挥官在等你。

scripts.text:
[Khalitzburg Knightage]
I had a weird dream last night. My mom was in it... Wonder if she is ok...
scripts.translation:
[卡利兹堡骑士团]
昨晚我做了个奇怪的梦，妈妈也在梦里...不知道她是否安好...

scripts.text:
[White Knight]
Please do not make a mess here.
scripts.translation:
[白骑士]
请不要在这里搞得一团糟。

scripts.text:
[Khalitzburg Knightage]
Orders please.
scripts.translation:
[卡利兹堡骑士团]
请下达命令。

scripts.text:
[White Knight]
How do you know Varmundt? I heard that he's not really a friendly man...
scripts.translation:
[白骑士]
你认识瓦尔蒙特？我听说他并不是个友善的人...

scripts.text:
[Khalitzburg Knightage]
Doesn't this castle seem weird all of a sudden? Something's not quite right.
scripts.translation:
[卡利兹堡骑士团]
这座城堡突然变得很奇怪，总觉得哪里不对劲。

scripts.text:
[White Knight]
I do not like to chat during work.
scripts.translation:
[白骑士]
我不喜欢在工作时闲聊。

scripts.text:
[Khalitzburg Knightage]
...
scripts.translation:
[卡利兹堡骑士团]
...

scripts.text:
[White Knight]
What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[白骑士]
有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text:
[Khalitzburg Knightage]
Is there something you need?
scripts.translation:
[卡利兹堡骑士团]
您有什么需要吗？

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
Where is your leader? I must talk to him.
scripts.translation:
[海因里希]
你们的首领在哪里？我必须和他谈谈。

scripts.text: Heinrich, you are in the castle now...
scripts.translation: 海因里希，你现在在城堡里...

scripts.text: Sir Heinrich. Varmundt...
scripts.translation: 海因里希大人。瓦尔蒙特...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sir Heinrich. Do you know what is happening in the castle now?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
海因里希大人。您知道城堡里现在正在发生什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
Aren't you the adventurer that came along with Varmundt?
scripts.translation:
[海因里希]
你难道不是和瓦尔蒙特一起来的冒险者吗？

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
What is it? Something wrong with the castle?
scripts.translation:
[海因里希]
怎么了？城堡出什么事了？

scripts.text: Himelmez's invasion...
scripts.translation: 希梅尔梅兹的入侵...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Dead man's Valkyrie, Himelmez is coming to take the Ymir's Heart piece hidden inside this castle!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
亡者的瓦尔基里希梅尔梅兹正赶来夺取藏在这座城堡里的依美乐心脏堆积物！

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
Haha. Funny. Do you really think that is possible?
scripts.translation:
[海因里希]
哈哈。真可笑。你真的认为这有可能吗？

scripts.text:
[Varmundt]
I'm not kidding, Sir Heinrich. If I'm correct, then she will be here very soon.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔蒙特]
我没有开玩笑，海因里希大人。如果我没猜错，她很快就会到了。

scripts.text:
[Varmundt]
We must hide the heart piece in a safe place before Himelmez's attack starts!
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔蒙特]
我们必须在希梅尔梅兹发动攻击前，把心脏堆积物藏到安全的地方！

scripts.text: Even if you don't believe me...
scripts.translation: 即使你不相信我...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can't make you believe me, but there's no time to argue!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我无法让你相信我，但现在没时间争论了！

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
Thank you for the help. But we don't even have our king with us right now.
scripts.translation:
[海因里希]
谢谢你的帮助。但我们现在连国王都不在身边。

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
We cannot risk moving the heart just because some stranger says so.
scripts.translation:
[海因里希]
我们不能仅凭一个陌生人的话，就冒险移动心脏堆积物。

scripts.text:
[Altar boy Domun]
Save me, save me, please...
scripts.translation:
[祭坛男孩 多蒙]
救救我，救救我，求求了...

scripts.text:
[Altar boy Domun]
Save me! Save me!!!
scripts.translation:
[祭坛男孩 多蒙]
救救我！救救我！！！

scripts.text: Hold on! Are you the only survivor?
scripts.translation: 等一下！你是唯一的幸存者吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hold on! Are you the only survivor?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等一下！你是唯一的幸存者吗？

scripts.text:
[Altar boy Domun]
Chamberlains... monks... They all turned into monsters. I couldn't do anything.
scripts.translation:
[祭坛男孩 多蒙]
侍从长...武僧...他们都变成了魔物。我什么都做不了。

scripts.text:
[Altar boy Domun]
All I could do was... Just hide in here... Nothing, nothing I could do...
scripts.translation:
[祭坛男孩 多蒙]
我只能...躲在这里...我什么都做不了...

scripts.text: Pull it together!
scripts.translation: 振作起来！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wake up kid! Go east and find the middle passage to the outside! It is safe there!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
醒醒，小孩！往东走，找到通往外面的中间通道！那里很安全！

scripts.text:
[Altar boy Domun]
To the east passage? Alone? How?
scripts.translation:
[祭坛男孩 多蒙]
去东边的通道？一个人？怎么过去？

scripts.text: I will give you a weapon.
scripts.translation: 我会给你一件武器。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here's a weapon. Just close your eye and swing for those monsters.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
给你一件武器。闭上眼睛，对着那些魔物挥砍吧。

scripts.text:
[Altar boy Domun]
Ok, I... I'll try.
scripts.translation:
[祭坛男孩 多蒙]
好，我...我会试试的。

scripts.text:
[Holgren the Destroyer]
You human?
scripts.translation:
[毁灭者 霍尔格伦]
你是人类？

scripts.text:
[Holgren the Destroyer]
Die!! You shall die!!!
scripts.translation:
[毁灭者 霍尔格伦]
去死！！你必死无疑！！！

scripts.text: Relax! I'm not a monster!
scripts.translation: 冷静点！我不是魔物！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Relax! I am Human. Are you alone? Is anyone else here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
冷静点！我是人类。你一个人吗？这里还有别人吗？

scripts.text:
[Holgren the Destroyer]
It's only me.
scripts.translation:
[毁灭者 霍尔格伦]
只有我一个。

scripts.text: It's dangerous here...
scripts.translation: 这里很危险...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's dangerous here. You know the way to the middle passage? Can you move?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这里很危险。你知道去中间通道的路吗？你能走动吗？

scripts.text:
[Holgren the Destroyer]
Yes, I can move. I need to get out of here.
scripts.translation:
[毁灭者 霍尔格伦]
是的，我能走。我必须离开这里。

scripts.text: Be safe...
scripts.translation: 保重...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sorry, I can't go with you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉，我不能和你一起去。

scripts.text:
[Holgren the Destroyer]
It's ok. You've already done enough. I can help myself. Good luck to you too.
scripts.translation:
[毁灭者 霍尔格伦]
没关系。你已经做得够多了，我能照顾好自己。也祝你一路顺风。

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
Himelmez... I will never forget what you've done to my men.
scripts.translation:
[海因里希]
希梅尔梅兹...我永远不会忘记你对我的部下所做的一切。

scripts.text: ^ff0000It seems like you have too many types or weights of items. Please organize your inventory.^000000
scripts.translation: ^ff0000您的物品种类或重量过多。请整理您的物品栏。^000000

scripts.text:
[Varmundt]
I guess this is it. Is it impossible to stop the time traveler's will?!
A portal seems to have appeared to the north.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔蒙特]
看来就是这里了。难道无法阻止那位时间旅行者的意志吗？！
北方似乎出现了一个传送门。

scripts.text:
[Varmundt]
This item has an extraordinary aura with it. Can be very useful for someone special.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔蒙特]
这件物品散发着非凡的气息。对于某些特别的人来说，它可能非常有用。

scripts.text:
[Himelmez]
Don't look at me nervous like that. It will be over soon...
scripts.translation:
[希梅尔梅兹]
别用那种紧张的眼神看着我。很快就要结束了...

scripts.text: ^0000ffIt seems that you did not receive a reward for clearing the first floor. Talk to Varmundt and receive your reward.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff您似乎没有领取第一层的通关奖励。请与瓦尔蒙特交谈以领取奖励。^000000

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
Himelmez's closed space covers everywhere...
scripts.translation:
[海因里希]
希梅尔梅兹的封闭空间笼罩着四面八方...

scripts.text:
[Varmundt]
How many times have I done this job? In my dream, I did it over and over again...
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔蒙特]
我做过多少次这份工作？在我的梦里，我一遍又一遍地重复着...

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
What are you putting on Himelmez!
scripts.translation:
[海因里希]
你在对希梅尔梅兹做什么！

scripts.text:
[Varmundt]
Can't take off this bridle...
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔蒙特]
摘不下来这个缰绳...

scripts.text:
[Gerhalt]
Uuuuu... Khhhah! Just run away with the commander.
scripts.translation:
[格哈特]
呜...咳！快跟着指挥官逃跑吧。

scripts.text:
[Himelmez]
That is amazing ~ you made it all the way here. May I say thank you?
scripts.translation:
[希梅尔梅兹]
真了不起~你竟然一路走到了这里。我可以道声谢吗？

scripts.text:
[Himelmez]
That is amazing ~ you made it all the way here. May I say thank you?
scripts.translation:
[希梅尔梅兹]
真了不起~你竟然一路走到了这里。我可以道声谢吗？

scripts.text: ^ff0000It seems like you have too many types or weights of items. Please organize your inventory.^000000
scripts.translation: ^ff0000您的物品种类或重量过多。请整理您的物品栏。^000000

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Hm, you are very well. First of all, let me give you some loot from Amdarais.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
嗯，你状态很好。首先，让我给你一些从暗答莱尸那里抢来的战利品。

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Varmundt's time is stopped by me.
And your time will be distorted soon.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
瓦尔蒙特的时间被我停住了。
而你的时间很快就会发生扭曲。

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Maybe this poor time traveler will try to stop Glast Heim's tragedy from happening.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
也许这位可怜的时间旅行者会试图阻止格拉斯特海姆的悲剧发生。

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
However, we will never overlook his behavior now and forever...
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
然而，无论过去还是未来，我们都绝不会忽视他的行为...

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Now let me remove your memory. If you see me again it will be someone new.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
现在让我抹去你的记忆。如果你再次见到我，那将是一个全新的人。

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Oops. I almost distorted the time gap. Come over here. We need to go out!
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
哎呀。我差点扭曲了时间缝隙。过来这边。我们需要出去！

scripts.text: You were just with me...
scripts.translation: 你刚才还和我在一起...

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
What did you say just before?
Anyway, that is not important. The gap of time will be closed so we need to get out of here.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
你刚才说什么来着？
总之，这不重要。时间缝隙即将关闭，我们必须离开这里。

scripts.text: Let me look around more
scripts.translation: 让我再四处看看

scripts.text: Please let me out
scripts.translation: 请让我出去

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Really? This place will be break down soon. Please look around quickly.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
真的吗？这个地方马上就要崩塌了。请快点四处看看。

scripts.text: The crack looks suspicious but nothing more to check.
scripts.translation: 裂缝看起来很可疑，但没有其他可疑之处。
